description: Compare the SERPINA6 proximal hinge and reactive centre loop against inhibitory and non-inhibitory serpins to test whether CBG can undergo the loop insertion required for protease inhibition
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACCS = {
 "P08185":("SERPINA6 (CBG)","?"),
 "P01009":("SERPINA1 (a1-antitrypsin)","INHIB"),
 "P01011":("SERPINA3 (a1-antichymotrypsin)","INHIB"),
 "P29622":("SERPINA4 (kallistatin)","INHIB"),
 "P05154":("SERPINA5 (PCI)","INHIB"),
 "P50452":("SERPINB8","INHIB"),
 "P01008":("SERPINC1 (antithrombin)","INHIB"),
 "P05121":("SERPINE1 (PAI-1)","INHIB"),
 "P05543":("SERPINA7 (TBG)","NON-INHIB"),
 "P01019":("SERPINA8 (angiotensinogen)","NON-INHIB"),
 "P36955":("SERPINF1 (PEDF)","NON-INHIB"),
 "P01012":("ovalbumin (SERPINB14, chicken)","NON-INHIB"),
 "P07602x":("skip","")}
ACCS.pop("P07602x")

recs={}
for a in ACCS:
    recs[a]=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=60).json()
seqs={a:recs[a]["sequence"]["value"] for a in recs}

# ---------- BLOSUM62 + affine NW ----------
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
L=B62.strip().split("\n"); cols=L[0].split(); B={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): B[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
sc=lambda a,b: B.get((a,b),-4)

def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for a in range(1,n+1): X[a,0]=go+ge*(a-1); pX[a,0]=1
    for b in range(1,m+1): Y[0,b]=go+ge*(b-1); pY[0,b]=2
    for a in range(1,n+1):
        ca=s1[a-1]
        for b in range(1,m+1):
            o=(M[a-1,b-1],X[a-1,b-1],Y[a-1,b-1]); k=int(np.argmax(o)); M[a,b]=o[k]+sc(ca,s2[b-1]); pM[a,b]=k
            o=(M[a-1,b]+go,X[a-1,b]+ge,Y[a-1,b]+go); k=int(np.argmax(o)); X[a,b]=o[k]; pX[a,b]=k
            o=(M[a,b-1]+go,X[a,b-1]+go,Y[a,b-1]+ge); k=int(np.argmax(o)); Y[a,b]=o[k]; pY[a,b]=k
    a,b=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]))); A1=[];A2=[]
    while a>0 and b>0:
        if st==0: A1.append(s1[a-1]);A2.append(s2[b-1]); st=pM[a,b]; a-=1;b-=1
        elif st==1: A1.append(s1[a-1]);A2.append("-"); st=pX[a,b]; a-=1
        else: A1.append("-");A2.append(s2[b-1]); st=pY[a,b]; b-=1
    while a>0: A1.append(s1[a-1]);A2.append("-");a-=1
    while b>0: A1.append("-");A2.append(s2[b-1]);b-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A1)),"".join(reversed(A2))

# ---------- anchor P1 ----------
cbg=seqs["P08185"]; pep="AVLQLNEEGVDTAGSTGV"; ix=cbg.find(pep)
cbg_P1=ix+len(pep)
print(f"CBG: NE-cleavage N-terminal peptide '{pep}' found at precursor {ix+1}-{cbg_P1}")
print(f"CBG P1 = {cbg[cbg_P1-1]}{cbg_P1} (precursor) = {cbg[cbg_P1-1]}{cbg_P1-22} (mature, signal pep 1-22). Literature: Val344. MATCH={cbg_P1-22==344}\n")

P1={"P08185":cbg_P1,"P01009":382,"P01011":383,"P29622":388,"P05154":373,
    "P50452":339,"P01008":425,"P05121":369,"P01012":353}
REF,REFP1="P01009",382
for acc in ["P05543","P01019","P36955"]:
    a1,a2=nw(seqs[REF],seqs[acc]); ri=qi=0; tgt=None
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!="-": ri+=1
        if c2!="-": qi+=1
        if ri==REFP1: tgt=qi if c2!="-" else None; break
    P1[acc]=tgt
    print(f"  P1 transferred by alignment: {acc} {ACCS[acc][0]:32s} -> {seqs[acc][tgt-1]}{tgt}")

# ---------- hinge analysis ----------
# Inhibitory serpin proximal-hinge consensus (Hopkins/Irving/Gettins):
#   P17 E, P16 x, P15 G, P14 T/S, P13 E/x, P12 A, P11 A, P10 A, P9 A/T/G/S
CONS={17:"E",15:"G",14:"TS",12:"AGS",11:"AGS",10:"AGS",9:"AGSTV"}
rows=[]
for acc,(lab,cls) in ACCS.items():
    s=seqs[acc]; p1=P1[acc]
    hinge="".join(s[p1-k] for k in range(17,8,-1))      # P17..P9
    rcl="".join(s[p1-k] for k in range(17,0,-1))+"|"+s[p1:p1+4]   # P17..P1 | P1'..P4'
    hits=sum(1 for k,allowed in CONS.items() if s[p1-k] in allowed)
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,protein=lab,known_class=cls,P1=f"{s[p1-1]}{p1}",
                     hinge_P17_P9=hinge,RCL_P17_P4prime=rcl,
                     hinge_consensus_hits=f"{hits}/7",hits_n=hits))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["known_class","hits_n"],ascending=[True,False])
pd.set_option("display.width",220); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",40)
print("\n=== Serpin proximal hinge (P17-P9) vs inhibitory consensus [P17 E, P15 G, P14 T/S, P12-P9 small] ===")
print(df[["protein","known_class","P1","hinge_P17_P9","RCL_P17_P4prime","hinge_consensus_hits"]].to_string(index=False))

inh=df[df.known_class=="INHIB"].hits_n; non=df[df.known_class=="NON-INHIB"].hits_n
cbgh=int(df[df.acc=="P08185"].hits_n.iloc[0])
from scipy import stats
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(inh,non,alternative="greater")
print(f"\nInhibitory (n={len(inh)}) hinge hits: mean {inh.mean():.2f} (range {inh.min()}-{inh.max()})")
print(f"Non-inhibitory (n={len(non)}) hinge hits: mean {non.mean():.2f} (range {non.min()}-{non.max()})")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u:.1f}, one-sided p={p:.4f}")
print(f"SERPINA6/CBG hinge hits = {cbgh}/7  -> groups with the NON-INHIBITORY serpins")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
colmap={"INHIB":"#2e6f9e","NON-INHIB":"#c0632b","?":"#8a1c3b"}
d2=df.sort_values("hits_n")
ax.barh(d2.protein,d2.hits_n,color=[colmap[c] for c in d2.known_class])
for y,(h,hs) in enumerate(zip(d2.hits_n,d2.hinge_P17_P9)):
    ax.text(h+0.08,y,hs,va="center",fontsize=8,family="monospace")
ax.set_xlim(0,9); ax.set_xlabel("Matches to inhibitory-serpin proximal hinge consensus (of 7 positions)")
ax.set_title("SERPINA6 (CBG) hinge matches non-inhibitory serpins, not inhibitory serpins")
import matplotlib.patches as mp
ax.legend(handles=[mp.Patch(color=colmap[k],label=l) for k,l in
          [("INHIB","inhibitory serpin"),("NON-INHIB","non-inhibitory serpin"),("?","SERPINA6 (tested)")]],loc="lower right",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.to_csv("serpina6_hinge_analysis.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved serpina6_hinge_analysis.csv")
